name: Attack Path Analysis
summary: Fenrir — chains the weaknesses Tenable already found into ranked paths to the crown jewels: remote exploits, local privilege escalation, credentials shared across hosts, NTLM relay, domain-controller flaws and failed compliance controls (LAPS, SMB signing, LLMNR, WDigest, sudo). Interactive attack map, diverse routes per crown jewel, choke points and a remediation bundle that cuts the most exposure. Reachability is inferred (no flow data). Gated tagging: Attack Path : Entry Point | Pivot | Target | Choke Point.
